gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-georama: Precise and tall-bellied, drawn like a pencil that never presses harder. Georama comes in friendly, its c pulled wide like a bracelet and its capitals barely rising, so a long paragraph glides along.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-hedvig-letters: Blockletter is precise, with joints that never thin or bulge. Where it excels at crisp, tall-bellied display lines, Hedvig Letters Sans excels at approachable text, its c clearly gapped and its small letters nearly capital height.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-hind-guntur: Blockletter is precise and modern, its tall midsection drawn as if by a pencil that never presses harder. And Hind Guntur brings the sturdy quality, tall stamped-metal lowercase with wide gaps and no thick-thin shift.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-karla: Blockletter does precise display work, with no calligraphic swelling anywhere along its outlines and a tall midsection. Karla counters with a gaping c and a tall, stocky middle band.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-kedebideri: Precise, modern, and tall-bellied, it reads like following a single pencil thread. Kedebideri lifts its lowercase to a skyward line, and its rounded letters stay open and inviting all the way down.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-montserrat-und: Precise Blockletter keeps a tall midsection and never presses any harder. Montserrat Underline follows with hollow-reed counters, round bowls with unswelling walls, and lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-sans-kr: Blockletter has a tall midsection and a ballpoint's pressure-free line, precise and modern. And Noto Sans KR brings generous curve gaps, a big x-height, and stubby ascenders and descenders that feel clean.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-sans-lydi: Modern Blockletter has a tall midsection with no pressure swells to slow the eye. And Noto Sans Lydian, with capitals close to lowercase height and a paper-clip-wide opening, keeps paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-sans-maha: No sparkle, just a constant stroke: Blockletter is precise and tall in the middle. Noto Sans Mahajani stands its lowercase tall against the capitals, with a funnel-wide throat in the e, so paragraphs read smoothly.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-sans-mala: A plain unmodulated outline defines Blockletter, with a tall midsection that feels precise and modern. And Noto Sans Malayalam lets its middle zone dominate the line, its s opening generously, so paragraphs settle into an easy texture.
